caveats: Synthetic visible-language labels are not actual user intent; themes and option orders are correlated repetitions.
New held-out scenes were frozen before the supplemental run; the same fixed prompt was used, without retuning.
Latency excludes screen capture, app IPC, key handling and debounce. MLX timings are in-process warm requests.
A queued word decision can wait behind the roughly 0.4-second image pass on a single serial model worker.
Base checkpoint, fine-tuning and quantization differ between Kev and the vision candidate; this is a system comparison, not an isolated ablation.
One numeric reference spotcheck differed by 0.1352 log-probability, beyond the original 0.1 tolerance; none of the 80 eligible full-reference winners changed.
Option softmax values are not calibrated confidence; blank or numeric images sometimes yield strong English preference.
Research only: no native capture, source switching, scheduling or permission handling has been installed or tested.
